name: svn-commit-ai
description: Generate SVN commit messages in Source Control using Copilot language models.

svnCommitAI.language.description: Language of the generated commit message.

svnCommitAI.style.default: Conventional Commits: a concise subject line (<= 72 chars), a blank line, then bullet points for key changes.
svnCommitAI.style.description: Style instructions for the commit message.

svnCommitAI.maxDiffChars.description: Maximum diff characters sent to the model.

svnCommitAI.modelFamily.description: Optional model family (e.g. gpt-4o). Empty = first available Copilot model.
